verdict.rationale: Source openness is a fair question for a cloud platform, but nothing in the evidence shows Google Cloud's own source is readable under an open license. The only open-source evidence covers peripheral ecosystem tools (MCP Toolbox for Databases, the Cloud Run MCP repo), which are adjacent components rather than the platform itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
